_comment: MCP servers the pipeline may use. ${NAME} is read from the environment or .env. 'required': true makes the readiness gate block when the server does not answer. 'stages' limits which agents get the server's tools. 'documentation': true marks a public documentation search server; the audit warns when none answers.

documentdb.purpose: Azure DocumentDB data-plane tools: queries, aggregation, index management, schema inspection

azure.purpose: Azure MCP Server: control-plane tools across Azure services and best-practice lookups

learn.purpose: Microsoft Learn documentation search and fetch. The source for checking facts and best practices
